sources.title: GitHub - Dhirendra10251/neuro-SORT: An event-driven, ultra-low-power ...
sources.snippet: Traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are highly accurate but notoriously power-hungry. When deploying AI to remote, edge-computing environments—such as industrial recycling plants or smart waste bins—battery life and thermal constraints become massive bottlenecks. NeuroSort solves this by utilizing a Spiking Neural Network (SNN).
